name: Button
statusNote: Five sizes (XS-XL) and a round/square shape choice per size are new in Expressive; the filled/tonal/outlined/elevated/text colour variants are unchanged in concept from baseline M3.
summary: A single-action button. Choose emphasis by colour style (filled > elevated ≈ tonal > outlined > text) and choose size by the density of the surrounding layout, not by importance.

inputs.name: leadingIcon
inputs.description: Optional leading icon. Expressive guidance favours one icon per button, leading or trailing, not both.

inputs.name: trailingIcon
inputs.description: Optional trailing icon; mutually preferred over leadingIcon, though Compose does not forbid both.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Selects the token group that drives container height, and buckets content padding, icon size and icon-label spacing from that height.

inputs.name: style
inputs.description: Colour style; selects the matching comp.*-button token group. Maps to the Compose composables Button, FilledTonalButton, OutlinedButton, ElevatedButton and TextButton.

inputs.name: shape
inputs.description: Resting silhouette, from the size's container-shape-round or container-shape-square token. Pick one per button; a button never mixes the two at rest.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: Disables the button and applies the style's disabled container/label opacities.

inputs.name: checkable
inputs.description: Makes the button a two-state toggle (Compose ToggleButton/ElevatedToggleButton/FilledTonalToggleButton/OutlinedToggleButton), changing its role to checkbox and adding the checked state. Not offered for the text style, which has no toggle composable.

inputs.name: checked
inputs.description: Current toggle state. Only meaningful when checkable is true; the caller owns it.

inputs.name: onCheckedChange
inputs.description: Called with the new checked value when a checkable button is clicked.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: Filled, tonal and elevated have a solid fill; outlined has a 1px stroke only; text has no container.

anatomy.name: Leading/trailing icon
anatomy.description: Optional, one or the other as a rule; a button can technically carry both slots but Expressive guidance favours one.

variants.description: Highest emphasis; primary action. Toggle colours (selected/unselected) also live in this group.
Medium-high emphasis. Only the plain (non-toggle) FilledTonalButton reads this group; the tonal toggle button reads comp.tonal-button instead — see notes.
Filled-tonal look plus a shadow; use on patterned or coloured surfaces only.
Low emphasis, tertiary/inline action. No toggle composable exists for this style.
Fully rounded resting shape, from container-shape-round.
Squared resting shape, from container-shape-square. Also the checked shape for a small toggle button by default.

layout.text: Content padding is chosen by container height bucket, not by the size prop directly: height < small → x-small padding, < medium → small padding, < large → medium padding, < x-large → large padding, else x-large padding.
Icon size and icon-label spacing are bucketed by the same container-height thresholds as content padding.
Minimum container width is a flat 58dp at every size; it is not tokenized.

Minimum height for the default (small) size is the small size's container-height token, except on precision-pointer input (mouse/trackpad), where it drops to a hardcoded 36dp regardless of the token. Implement this as a separate pointer-precision min-height override, not as a sixth size.
On precision-pointer input, the small button's vertical padding also drops from 10dp to a hardcoded 8dp, and its leading padding switches to a hardcoded 12dp instead of the leading-space token.
Vertical content padding by size is hardcoded, not tokenized: x-small 6dp; small 8dp normally, 10dp on touch; medium 16dp; large 32dp.
A button containing only an icon (no label) uses a hardcoded 16dp leading content padding instead of the leading-space token.

Icon size defaults to a flat 18dp rather than any size token, marked in Compose as a placeholder pending a corrected baseline-button value; the per-size icon-size tokens are what actually get used once bucketed by height, so this 18dp fallback is not normally observed.
Extra-small icon-label spacing is a hardcoded 4dp, not sourced from a token, pending a correction to the x-small token value.

states.text: Every button has a resting shape and a pressed shape and animates between them on press/release, using the size's pressed-container-shape token.

A checkable button adds a third, checked shape from the size's selected-container-shape-round or selected-container-shape-square token (round morphs to square when checked at small size); role becomes checkbox, not button.

Checked/unchecked colours come from the style's own selected-*/unselected-* tokens (filled, elevated, outlined), except the tonal toggle, which reads comp.tonal-button's selected-*/unselected-* tokens instead of comp.filled-tonal-button.
Each style applies its own disabled container and label/icon opacities independently; no additional hardcoded alpha is layered on top.
Elevated buttons track hovered elevation from the style's token group; filled/tonal/outlined/text use their hovered label/icon colour tokens only.
Applies the style's focused icon/label colour tokens; elevated additionally applies its focused-container-elevation token.

behaviour.text: A checkable button calls onCheckedChange(!checked) on click; the caller owns the checked value.

Toggle button's default pressed shape at small size is hardcoded to a 6dp rounded rectangle, diverging from the small size's pressed-container-shape token; x-small/medium/large/x-large toggle pressed shapes do use their own size token correctly. This is very likely an upstream oversight; a from-scratch kit can simply always use the size's pressed-container-shape token for consistency.
Elevated button's shadow tracks rest/pressed/focused/hovered/disabled elevation, all sourced from the elevated-button token group; no hardcoded elevation numbers are used.

keyboard: Tab moves focus to the button.
For a checkable button, Space or Enter also toggles checked and the checkbox role's checked state is announced.
semantics: Screen readers announce the label text.
An icon-only button (no label) must carry an explicit content description; there is no fallback text to announce.
A checkable button uses the checkbox role, not the button role, and announces checked/unchecked, not a mutually-exclusive radio choice.

notes.text: button.md's own token list names comp.tonal-button and comp.baseline-button alongside the five style groups, but Button.kt (the plain, non-toggle composables) never imports TonalButtonTokens or reads any BaselineButtonTokens colour/shape field. comp.tonal-button is live only as ToggleButton.kt's colour source for the tonal toggle variant (see the checked-state note below); comp.baseline-button is effectively dead.

comp.baseline-button's colour tokens (container-color, icon-color, label-text-*, selected-*/unselected-*, disabled-*) and its size/shape tokens (container-height, container-shape-round/square, icon-size, icon-label-space, pressed-container-shape, selected-container-shape-*) are never read anywhere in Button.kt or ToggleButton.kt. Only leading-space and trailing-space are read, and only as the legacy single-size ButtonDefaults.ContentPadding default, which the height-bucketed contentPaddingFor() logic supersedes in practice for every documented size.

The tonal toggle button (FilledTonalToggleButton) reads its selected/unselected colours from comp.tonal-button, not from comp.filled-tonal-button (the group the plain FilledTonalButton uses). comp.filled-tonal-button itself has no selected-*/unselected-* fields at all, so do not look for toggle colours there for the tonal style.

comp.filled-tonal-button carries container-height, container-shape, icon-size and label-text-font fields that no other style group has and that Button.kt/ToggleButton.kt never read — the actual height/shape/icon-size for every style come from the per-size comp.button-* groups instead.
There is no text-toggle composable in ToggleButton.kt; the text style cannot be made checkable, unlike filled/tonal/outlined/elevated.
